scenarios.proves: on-device FETCH-BASED INSTALL: dsh-notes bytes handed to the carrier over the bus seam (http.serve), served by the loopback carrier over real TCP (http.route-registered + http.served, 3584 bytes), installed through installFromFetch with the REAL gateway httpFetch (install.fetch.start url http://127.0.0.1:<port>/packages/dsh-notes-0.1.0.tar -> streaming body 3584 bytes -> blob digest eb478c29… matching the pinned fixture digest) — full receipt transaction with the append-only journal (receipt.pending -> install.committed); two crash-simulated pending receipts STARTUP-REPLAYED (m3-f002 staged-verifies -> replay.committed; m3-f003 staging-incomplete -> replay.rolled-back, installed tree verified untouched); then the m2.session-shaped agent session (host.info gated on the admitted slot's ack, 5 streamed deltas, one subprocess tool call persisted via dsh-fs)
